name: Land Of The Free
review:
A patriotic 5x4 with reel 5 locked in the base game and a conveyor belt under the bottom row. Each spin, the conveyor can bring different features that change the reels, and crates of bottles add more.

Fully stacked character symbols turn into stacked wilds, and all reels unlock in the bonus. xSplit and xGOD add even more potential. Extreme volatility, 57,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
